description: Manages enterprise customer queries, handles billing adjustments, and escalates critical system outages per SLA matrix.
Builds BI telemetry dashboards, performs data warehouse ETL transformations, and adheres to data privacy and anonymization standards.
Diagnoses production software issues, writes patch bug fixes, executes PR peer reviews, and enforces Secure SDLC standards.
Audits corporate expense claims against per diem limits, coordinates RFP vendor bidding, and maintains invoice ledger accuracy.
Oversees new hire onboarding curricula, leave balances, performance review calibration, and employee offboarding logistics.
Oversees physical access security, visitor registration and badging, facility health and safety, and hardware asset recovery.
Enforces 80% automated test coverage gates, manages regression testing cycles, and governs production release blockers.
Manages Kubernetes infrastructure, Blue-Green zero-downtime deployment pipelines, and automated secret rotation via HashiCorp Vault.
Monitors SIEM telemetry, investigates security breach alerts within 24h SLA, audits IAM hardware MFA enforcement, and validates encryption standards.
Defines product roadmaps, validates compliance requirements with stakeholders, prioritizes feature backlogs, and coordinates quarterly OKRs.
